title: Terder's Potato Shader
description: A lightweight, optimized shader designed specifically for low-end and potato PCs.
body:
This is a simple, lightweight shader built with performance in mind. It is optimized to run smoothly on low-end hardware, older laptops, and potato PCs without sacrificing too much visual quality. 

If you need a budget-friendly effect that keeps your game's FPS high, this shader is for you.

Why Choose This Shader?
Minimal GPU Impact: Strips away unnecessary complex calculations, ensuring your GPU stays cool and your framerate stays high.

True Potato Optimization: No bloat, no unnecessary post-processing effects—just the bare essentials to make your world look better.

Fast Loading: Optimized for quick loading times without causing micro-stutters.

Visual Enhancements:

Optimized Water

Enhanced Shadows

and more!

Key Highlights:
- Lightweight: Very low vertex/fragment complexity.
- Potato PC Approved: Tested to maintain high FPS on weak hardware.

Requirements
To use this shader, you need to install one of the following mods:

- Iris Shader

Installation Instructions
Ensure you have a shader-compatible mod installed (Iris Shader)

Download the .zip file from the file section.

Open Minecraft and navigate to Options -> Video Settings -> Shader Packs.

Click Open Shader Packs Folder.

Drag and drop the downloaded .zip file into that folder.

Select the shader in-game and enjoy!
